title: Great-work type
description: A type of great work: its slot type, how works are created and what a displayed work yields. The ID also names the slot type. One file per type in content/greatworks/<id>.json.

source.description: Whether works come from creativity or from discovery.

baseCreativity.description: Creativity the first work needs. Only for source creativity.

growthPercent.description: How much more each later work needs than the last, in percent. Only for source creativity.

cultureByEra.description: Culture per day a displayed work yields, by the era it was made in; the first entry is era 1.
